sources.citation: Oldendorp, Christian Georg Andreas. 1777. Geschichte der Mission der evangelischen Brueder auf den caraibischen Inseln S. Thomas, S. Croix und S. Jan. Theil 1. Barby. (BSB scan, archive.org item 11129612bsb, scanned text)
sources.note: Nothing. Okwa appears as an African 'nation' in ethnographic remarks (pp. 306-307) and with exactly one entry in the comparative vocabulary table of names for God: 'Okwa: Tschabee' (scanned line 21680). No other Okwa words, no grammatical or phonetic remarks.
